title: This 'Claude Watermark Remover' Skill Is FAKE - I Checked The Code
description:
Anthropic just started watermarking everything Claude writes — and within days, reels are going viral telling you to install a GitHub "skill" that supposedly strips it out completely.
I checked the actual repo. It installs into Grok's skill folder, not Claude's — there's no Claude install path in the docs at all. And buried in the README: "no tool can honestly certify this fails the official check."
The people who built the tool are more honest about it than the people going viral pushing it.

github repo link:

https://github.com/guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover


Hashtags: #claudeai #aitools #devtools #antihype #softwareengineering
